frozen_armor.slvl_note: 1 hard + 8 all-skills + 6 Sorceress skills (Oculus 3, Torch 3) + 1 Battle Command (always on, KP-437)
frozen_armor.freeze_law: on damagedinmelee with physical damage > 0 (D2MOO SkillSor.cpp EventFunc02_FrozenArmor), apply freeze length = 30 + 3x(slvl-1) frames (calc1 = ln56, synergy 0). Freeze length FREEZES normal and minion monsters and only CHILLS champions, uniques, superuniques and bosses (Basin Freeze length; C-13 KP-426 laws); length x (100 - target cold res)/100, then /4 in Hell (DifficultyLevels MonsterFreezeDivisor 4); cold-immune targets are unaffected

Oculus.trigger: When Struck: hit by melee, or by a missile applying weapon/monster damage (NOT by missiles that apply only their own or skill damage) — Basin When Struck
Oculus.effect: Teleport cast with the user as caster and no player-chosen target (Basin lists it as cast 'on the user'); the destination comes from the skill's target resolution (D2MOO SrvDo027 uses the target XY) — the destination rule for an untargeted cast is UNVERIFIED here

Hellfire Torch.trigger: On Striking: only a WEAPON attack that is not missed/blocked/dodged triggers it (Basin On Striking)
Hellfire Torch.effect_for_this_kit: Fire Ball / Meteor are spells, not weapon attacks, so the Torch Firestorm effectively NEVER fires for this kit (INFERRED from the trigger law)
